pandas.testing.assert_index_equal

pandas 3.1.1 · Testing, errors, and warnings · function

Compare two indexes and raise AssertionError when the configured equality checks fail.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.testing.assert_index_equal(…) Full signature
pd.testing.assert_index_equal(
    left,
    right,
    exact=…,
    check_names=True,
    check_exact=True,
    check_categorical=True,
    check_order=True,
    rtol=1e-05,
    atol=1e-08,
    obj=None,
    *,
    check_freq=…,
)
